observations: The hidden-rubric unit produced 3/3 only for its three exact current-provider tasks and conditions.
Legacy retained-negative entries vary in how explicitly they name candidate, configuration, and conditions.
A deterministic scope audit is the smallest unit that prevents unsupported family-wide inference while preserving useful exact evidence.
fragment.purpose: Turn revision 20's anti-overgeneralization rule into falsifiable repository evidence before further scientist-agent-derived conclusions accumulate.
unresolved: which scientist-agent-derived mechanisms merit later direct testing

observations: Positive internal results and negative legacy results both require exact causal scope.
Provenance-equivalent controls should be reused, while non-equivalent controls remain genuinely missing.
local_learn.reason: Select a bounded evidence-hygiene execution unit; do not activate or modify a Candidate from three internal cases.

evidence_needed: a complete inventory of in-scope negative entries with stable source locators
for each entry, explicit tested target, candidate/version, configuration, conditions, and the narrow supported conclusion
a machine-checkable list of ambiguous or overbroad claims and the exact bounded replacement wording
positive-control provenance equivalence decisions that distinguish reuse from genuinely missing control evidence
tests proving that family-wide or untested-mechanism conclusions are rejected unless separately supported
expected_outputs: one deterministic negative-evidence scope ledger and validation report
zero unsupported scientist-agent-family or untested-mechanism generalizations
an explicit repair list for ambiguous legacy entries without rewriting their underlying observations
a continuation to Task Evaluate with the user-level objective still FAIL unless broader independent evidence actually exists
failure_conditions: any tested variant result is generalized to the scientist-agent family or an untested mechanism
an existing control is treated as equivalent without adequate provenance
a provenance-equivalent control is needlessly required to be reproduced
missing configuration or conditions are guessed
internal audit results are relabeled as AGI, independent production evidence, or completion
result.goal: Audit every currently retained scientist-agent-derived or O-adapted negative-evidence entry and produce a deterministic scope ledger that names the exact tested candidate, configuration, conditions, and supported conclusion, flags any broader unsupported wording, and reuses any provenance-equivalent established control without demanding a duplicate reproduction.
inputs: agi/WORK_STRATEGY.json retained_negative_evidence and related successor/diagnostic entries
available exact commit, workflow, artifact, and configuration references already persisted in the repository
the current behavioral result only as three exact scoped internal observations, not as family-wide evidence
result.parent_continuation: After the bounded ledger audit is evaluated, continue with the highest-information executable experiment toward the unmet upper objective. Do not treat audit completion, one test, one PR, or the three-case internal result as a stopping condition.
result.rollback: On any missing or ambiguous provenance, preserve the original entry, mark its conclusion scope unresolved, emit the exact missing fields, and do not broaden, delete, or semantically rewrite the underlying evidence.
success_conditions: every audited conclusion is bounded to its actual candidate, configuration, and tested conditions
equivalent established controls are reused by recorded provenance instead of duplicated
ambiguous source data fails closed and remains labeled ambiguous rather than being inferred
the ledger and validator replay deterministically and protected tests remain green
